### `get_folder_custom_fields`

**Get Folder Custom Fields** · `GET /api/v2/folder/{folder_id}/field` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View the Custom Fields you have access to in a Folder. Get Folder Custom Fields only returns Custom Fields created at the Folder level. Custom Fields created at the List level are not included.

Custom Fields scoped to specific custom task types include an `applied_objects` array on each field object. Each entry has `object_type` (`19` for custom task type) and `object_id` (the custom task type ID, matching `custom_item_id` on tasks). Use [Get Custom Task Types](custom_task_types.md#get_custom_task_types) to resolve IDs to names. Fields without task-type scoping omit `applied_objects`. Workspace-scoped Custom Fields are included when querying a Folder.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder_id` | path | number | yes |  |
| `include_applied_objects` | query | boolean |  | When `true`, includes `applied_objects` on task-type-scoped Custom Fields in the response. (default `false`) |

### `remove_custom_field_value`

**Remove Custom Field Value** · `DELETE /api/v2/task/{task_id}/field/{field_id}` · API v2 · 🔴 destructive

Remove the data from a Custom Field on a task. This does not delete the option from the Custom Field.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | path | string | yes |  |
| `field_id` | path | string | yes | b8a8-48d8-a0c6-b4200788a683 (uuid) |
| `custom_task_ids` | query | boolean |  | If you want to reference a task by it's custom task id, this value must be `true`. |
| `team_id` | query | number |  | When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`. |

### `set_custom_field_value`

**Set Custom Field Value** · `POST /api/v2/task/{task_id}/field/{field_id}` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Add data to a Custom field on a task.

You'll need to know the `task_id` of the task you want to update, and the universal unique identifier (UUID) `field_id` of the Custom Field you want to set.

The Custom Field must be applicable to the task's current `custom_item_id`. Use [Get Custom Fields](#get_list_custom_fields) (check each field's `applied_objects`) or [Get Task](tasks.md#get_task) to find applicable `field_id` values.

Returns `400` if the field is not enabled for the task's custom task type.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | path | string | yes | Enter the task ID of the task you want to update. |
| `field_id` | path | string | yes | Enter the universal unique identifier (UUID) of the Custom Field you want to set. |
| `custom_task_ids` | query | boolean |  | If you want to reference a task by its Custom Task ID, this value must be `true`. |
| `team_id` | query | number |  | When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |
